reason: The text demonstrates Yahweh's care for His people throughout. Key evidence includes: (1) God hears the groaning of the Israelites and remembers His covenant (Exodus 2:24-25); (2) God comes down to rescue them from Egyptian oppression (Exodus 3:8); (3) God provides the Passover as a protective act, marking the Israelites' homes so the firstborn are spared (Exodus 12); (4) God leads them through the Red Sea to safety while destroying the pursuing Egyptian army (Exodus 14); (5) God provides manna from heaven to feed them in the wilderness (Exodus 16); (6) God provides water from the rock at Rephidim when they're thirsty (Exodus 17); (7) God actively fights for Israel against Amalek (Exodus 17). Throughout these passages, Yahweh responds to His people's needs, delivers them from danger, and provides materially for their survival.
